newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian Occidental outlines well results.
newsitem.headline: Canadian Occidental outlines well results.

text.p: Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd said on Friday its CXY Energy Offshore Inc unit has discovered natural gas at Eugene Island offshore Louisiana.
The OCS-G-14467 well number 1, located in 70 feet of water, was drilled to a depth of 18,300 feet and encountered two zones totalling about 200 feet of gross interval.

The company said one zone was tested at a rate of 16.5 million cubic feet per day of gas and 650 barrels of condensate on a 20/64 inch choke at a flowing tubing pressure of 9050 pounds per square inch.
CanOxy said plans for additional development of this discovery in 1997 are being evaluated at this moment.

CanOxy has 15 percent working interest in the property while Enron Oil & Gas Co is the operator with a 50 percent working interest. Seagull Energy Corp holds 20 percent at Box Energy Corp owns 15 percent.
CanOxy plans to continue to focus on the Gulf of Mexico, offshore Louisiana and Texas.
